description:
Changes what Clients see and how MTD Chase behaves for this practice: name shown to Clients, reply-to email, sign-off, phone shown on the Client's page, how many days before the HMRC deadline Clients are asked to send by (0–30, default 10; applies to Chases started afterwards), how many days after a deadline files are kept (30–365), daily summary email on/off, and the default checklist new Chases ask Clients for (1–8 items; running Chases keep theirs). Returns before → after.
Use this when: the practitioner changes their details, the date clients are asked to send by, their default checklist, or retention.

ask_by_days.description: 0–30: days before the HMRC deadline that clients are asked to send by

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

phone.description: UK phone number shown to Clients; empty clears it

retention_days.description: 30–365: days after the HMRC deadline that files are kept

name: update_practice
title: Update practice settings
